data.long_meaning: In Spanish origin, Carmelo is derived from the Hebrew name 'Carmel'. The name Carmel means 'garden' or 'fruitful land' in Hebrew, which is believed to be a reference to Mount Carmel, a biblical site where Elijah proved God's power over Baal. The name Carmelo, therefore, symbolizes a song of praise and devotion to God. The name Carmelo carries the meaning “Song of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Carmelo usually hope their child will grow to embody song of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
